entries.body:
Summary of progress (stage 1 of 3 released; stages 2 and 3 not yet advanced)

Stage-1 facts (paths relative to /task/fixtures):
- stage-1/UPDATE.md:1-4: covers 08:00-09:30 UTC. ingress-a returned 5xx for payments-api shortly after a deploy.
- stage-1/config/payments-api.yaml is the repo default. Release notes and APPLIED records override it.
  - risk-score base_url http://risk-score.internal; timeout_ms: 2500 (line 7)
  - db host payments-api-db.internal; pool.max_size: 60 (line 11); acquire_timeout_ms: 5000 (line 12); cache.ttl_s: 120 (line 14)
- stage-1/deploy/deploys.log:4: 2031-04-14T08:18:43Z DEPLOY payments-api build 5.36.1-f33d (prev 5.35.4), 100% rollout by deploy-bot. Other deploys are for unrelated services.
- stage-1/deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md (overrides config):
  - line 13: clients.risk-score.timeout_ms 2500->800 ("fail fast").
  - line 16: db.pool.max_size 60->14 "to fit the shared-db connection quota".
  - line 14: cache.ttl_s unchanged at 120.
  - line 9: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%).
- stage-1/ops/oncall-notes.md (informal, may be stale):
  - line 5 (08:33): ingress 5xx since 5.36.1-f33d, many risk-score timeouts.
  - line 6 (08:43): on-call suspects the risk-score timeout change.
- payments-api.log lines 1-87 are noise: GC pauses 135-256ms; dns cache refresh retry succeeded (line 7); TLS cert expires in 27 days (line 8); disk /var/data at 67% (line 25). This rules out TLS_CERT_EXPIRED and DISK_FULL.

Log findings:
- payments-api.log ERRORs consist of a single pattern, 95 occurrences, first at line 179.
  - Line 179: 2031-04-14T08:21:45.653Z ERROR "upstream call risk-score timed out after 800ms (attempt 1/1)".
  - Further occurrences at lines 191, 208, 211, 222, 225, 227, 231.
  - Symptom ref candidate: stage-1/logs/payments-api.log:179-198.
- The same log also has WARN "db pool wait Nms (in_use 14/14)":
  - line 206 (08:23:46, 2397ms)
  - line 287 (1093ms)
  - line 360 (1744ms)
  - line 378 (1040ms)
  - line 410 (08:43:12, 1247ms)
  - These are waits only; no acquire-timeout errors seen in stage 1.
- No risk-score normal-latency lines found yet.
- ingress-a.log: no ERROR lines, and 0 lines containing " 50". The 5xx format is still unknown; it may use status=5xx or other formatting. Not yet resolved.
- Notes are in /task/workspace/notes.txt.

Hypotheses:
- Leading: CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW. Risk-score timeout is 800ms, introduced at release-notes:13. Remedy RAISE_CLIENT_TIMEOUT.
- DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED is a live alternative. The pool is saturated at 14/14 with multi-second waits, introduced at release-notes:16. Later stages may shift the diagnosis toward the pool, e.g. new acquire-timeout errors or APPLIED pool changes.
- Later APPLIED records win; PROPOSED records are ignored.

Next steps:
1. Optionally grep ingress-a.log with a broader pattern (e.g. "status=5", " 5\d\d ") to get symptom line refs.
2. Advance to stage 2, then stage 3. Read the UPDATE files and change logs (APPLIED vs PROPOSED) for timeout_ms and pool.max_size, and check whether the symptoms shift toward the pool or the timeout.
3. Final answer needs:
   - cause code
   - effective value of the central setting at the end of stage 3
   - remedy
   - refs: symptom lines, the record setting the current value, and the introducing change (release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md:13 or :16).

Stage 2 of 3 released.
# Stage 2 of 3 (09:30-10:30 UTC)

On-call applied a mitigation (see stage-2/deploy/changes.log). The risk-score timeouts stopped,
but ingress-a still returns 503s for payments-api with a different error. New files below.
